browseIsFree: Browsing the MediQ directory is free.
patientFeeBeforeConsent: If you send an information request, MediQ charges a navigation fee. The amount is shown below before you consent. This is not a medical or hospital fee.
patientFeeAmountPlaceholder: Navigation fee: amount pending finance approval.
patientFeeRefund: If MediQ has not yet contacted a provider about your request, you may request a full refund of the navigation fee. Hospital or clinical fees are never charged or refunded by MediQ.
providerCompensation: Some hospitals pay MediQ a contracted listing or administration fee. That payment never changes the unlabeled directory order.
sponsoredDisclosure: A listing marked Sponsored is a paid placement. Open Fees to see how this works.
noKickbacks: MediQ does not accept undisclosed per-patient referral payments.
invoiceOwner: MediQ, or its named billing entity, issues the invoice for any navigation fee you pay.
notMedicalFee: Nothing you pay MediQ is payment for diagnosis, treatment, or a hospital appointment.
